changes.affirmative_summary: Manual 8.7, 9.2, 10.2 and Prilog 2 require prompt identification and action, cause analysis for significant or repeated problems, recurrence prevention, recorded results, management reports and verified completion/effectiveness. PQ10.2-2 revision 10 sections 2.2, 2.5, 2.7 and 3.1-3.8 assign the cause, approval, follow-up, reopening and reporting duties. These are written controls, not only standard references.
changes.contrary_summary: The real audit still needs samples showing timely closure and effective recurrence prevention. Separately, confirm the applicable Part 21 reporting path beyond customer notification in PQ10.2-1 section 3.11. Neither an unchecked work sample nor that separate reporting question is a missing Appendix B XVI corrective-action policy.
changes.judge_ruling: Fully matched for documentation, 5/5. The supplied written controls cover Appendix B XVI and NQA-1 Part I Requirement 16 paragraph 100. This is not a claim of verified field performance or full Part 21 compliance.
changes.rationale: Raise 75 to 100 points: the previous deduction was based on a separate Part 21 reporting check rather than a missing corrective-action duty. Linked manual crumbs APP_B_XVI-0004, 0007, 0008 and 0010 show significant/repeated cause review, prompt action, prevention of recurrence, records, verification and management reports; PQ10.2-2 revision 10 provides assigned implementation/follow-up duties. Keep Part 21 and completed-action sampling as explicit audit follow-up. Apply the document-scoring rubric of 2026-10-07 without changing the approved five-level weights.
